steps.content: Before you can even react, the white ghost catches up to you with a whoosh.
It wraps one of its pale ghost hand around your hands, while the other hand is poised to reach into your candy basket...
Summoning strength into your hands, you throw yourself in front of the candy basket, obstructing the little ghost's advance. You and the ghost are now locked in a stalemate...
Until the sound of a suona breaks it.
The white ghost's hands freeze mid-air as both you and the ghost look up at Dudu the Witch.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Since ${PlayerName} is guarding the candy so valiantly, let's not snatch it away by force. How about we play a little game instead?

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: If you win, not only will you not have to give any of your candy to my little pet, but I, the Great Witch, will bestow a reward upon you!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...So, when you talked about not letting it catch up with me, were you just trying to scare me?

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Oh, come on, it was to sharpen your vigilance!
